tools.name: press_release_guidelines
tools.description: Returns the PressPilot method to write a press release journalists actually read: structure, length, tone and what to avoid. Useful when drafting or reviewing a press release.

tools.name: find_journalists
tools.description: Counts the verified journalists in the PressPilot database (46,000+ contacts, 78 countries) who match a country, media type and/or sector. Returns only counts by media type, sector and country, never names or emails. Criteria come from the user's business and announcement.

tools.name: prepare_press_release_send
tools.description: Saves the press release and a selection of matching journalists on PressPilot, and returns a link where the user creates a free account, reviews the text and the selection, and sends it from their own email address. Nothing is sent from the chat.
